name: Weather
reason: Folks, this week's setup is only lukewarm for blooms, with highs averaging a modest 26.4C and a decent 22.6 mm of rain stirring the water, so I'm leaning against a bloom but not ruling it out.
evidence: Average max temp of 26.4C is warm but below the 30C bloom-favouring threshold
Only 1 hot day this week, so no sustained heat run
22.6 mm of rain total can mix and flush the water column
Late June timing means the season is warming, keeping some bloom chance alive
